The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 5. Payment

PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Performance Guarantee: The value of performance guarantee is 5% of the value of contract, with validit y of 6 months above the contract period. The performance guarantee should be submitted within 30 days from the contract generation date to user department which shall stand refundable after successful compl etion of the contract subject to certificate from user department that there are no pending dues whatsoev er against the contractor. 2. The Earnest Money deposit shall be rounded to nearest Rs 10. 3. AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Maharashtra or Karnataka. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED 4. The vehicle is required for Sr.DEN/S/SUR of Engg. dept. Thus it can be used for Inter-state operation acro ss Maharashtra and Karnataka states. 5. The bid is abided by General Conditions of Contract (GCC) Services - 2018 and its latest correction slip; t he bidder has to go through the details accordingly. 6. The bidders are required to submit the following documents: PAN, GST Registration, Work Experience Pr oof (if required), Turnover Certificate (issued by a CA), Liquidity Proof (issued by a CA or bank reference), L abour Compliance Affidavit, Copy of EMD Payment, and MSME/NSIC Certificate (if any) 7. The rate to be quoted inclusive of all applicable taxes including GST 8. The tender accepting authority reserves all rights to deal with this tender. 9. Vehicle should not be older than 03 years at the time of opening of Bid. (Fuel: Diesel, petrol, CNG only) 10. RC Copy/Invoice for purchase of vehicle to be submitted in the name of owner/firm, and if these docum e nts/vehicle are provided for a different name, then an MOU to be attached duly notarised for providing of said vehicle for the service of the tender mentioning the Bid Number in the document. Submitted RC Copy should not be older than 3 years; the same vehicle should not be older than 3 years 11. Order(s) will be placed on the Bidder who must have satisfactorily executed at least one single Contra ct order (it also includes Ongoing Service Contracts) of Zonal Railways/ PUs/ C ORE/PSUs/State Governmen t/Govt. Autonomous Bodies for the same work [OR similar work as mentioned in Bid Document] for a minim um of 35 percent of total bid value during previous three years. This period of three years shall be counted with respect to date of tender closing. The payment certificate duly signed by the Competent Authority sh all be submitted by the Bidder. Certificates from Private Individuals shall not be accepted. 12. After award of contract, within 07 days bidder shall submit vehicle details (a) RC Copy (b) PUC (C) Insu rance (d) Driver details ETC to consignee. 13. Cost offered would be inclusive of all tolls, parking charges, Night charges, etc. 14. The vehicle provided for services of this work must be a commercial vehicle, and also vehicle details s ubmitted during bidding are deployed for executing service of this work. 15. Failure to comply with the above conditions will make the contract liable for termination, and the Performance Guarantee (PG) will be forfeited Note: The following conditions have been incorporated in the bid documents: Hiring of 01 No. Non-AC SUV on a monthly basis for 24 months, with a monthly package of 1800 km x 364 hour s (Outstation 24×7), at a rate of Rs.54,000 per month, amounting to Rs.12,96,000 for 24 mont hs. The successful bidder shall be entitled to payment for extra running up to 1,000 km per m onth at th e rate of Rs.12 per km. Accordingly, the extra kilometre provision is calculated as 0 1 vehicle × 1,000 km × 24 months = 24,000 km × Rs.12 = Rs.2,88,000. Therefore, the total est imated contract value for 24 months is Rs.15,84,000.
